note: Derived question-keyed stop-profile map for one concrete successor comparison. It keeps semantic stopping points separate from audience-specific start paths and escalation order so later notes can cite one home for approved terminal fields.

approved_stop_fields.why: This is the narrow continuity owner that the public wrapper compresses.
This is the narrow closure owner that the public wrapper compresses.

semantic_pieces.question: Does the successor remain continuous with the base claim?
semantic_pieces.why: The wrapper sentence compresses a continuity decision.

semantic_pieces.question: Did the successor ship the required publication outputs?
semantic_pieces.why: The wrapper sentence also compresses publication closure.

profiles.why: The public status sentence is a two-piece wrapper claim; do not stop at wrapper prose when one half is contested.

approved_stop_fields.why: This is the row-level bridge from obligation profile to closure verdict.
This is the compressed closure token that later papers may cite once the role rows are understood.

semantic_pieces.question: Which required publication roles were actually satisfied?
semantic_pieces.why: Referee review often starts from the role-row bridge rather than the compressed closure token.

semantic_pieces.question: What is the compressed package-closure status token?
semantic_pieces.why: Some later notes need only the narrow closure answer once the role rows are known.

profiles.why: Package completeness has both a row-level and a compressed-token stopping point; the question decides which is enough.

approved_stop_fields.why: The status envelope owns the narrow public-status token directly.
This is the continuity-side owner compressed into the public-status token.
This is the closure-side owner compressed into the public-status token.

semantic_pieces.question: What narrow public-status token was emitted?
semantic_pieces.why: The envelope owns the token itself.

semantic_pieces.question: Which continuity decision makes that token true?
semantic_pieces.why: A challenged token may force inspection of the continuity verdict it compresses.

semantic_pieces.question: Which closure decision makes that token true?
semantic_pieces.why: A challenged token may also force inspection of publication closure.

profiles.why: Auditor review may stop at the token itself or continue to the narrower verdict owners if the token is challenged.

approved_stop_fields.why: This is the smallest numeric diff owner.
This is the replay-facing recomputation witness for the numeric delta.
This is the narrow changed-family owner used by downstream maintenance notes.

semantic_pieces.question: What numeric diff was observed across the release pair?
semantic_pieces.why: The compact diff sentence compresses compare-report deltas.

semantic_pieces.question: What recomputed replay totals support that diff if challenged?
semantic_pieces.why: Auditor review may escalate to the replay-facing recomputation object.

semantic_pieces.question: Which line-item families actually changed?
semantic_pieces.why: The compact diff sentence also implies a narrow changed-family slice.

profiles.why: Compact diff questions split naturally into numeric delta, replay recomputation, and changed-family pieces.

resolution_rule: Pick the stop profile keyed by question family and stop only at one of its approved_stop_fields for the contested semantic piece.

stop_contract.branch_link_rule: A companion piece-keyed challenge-branch map may cite stop_profile_key and piece_key but may not invent new approved terminal fields.
stop_contract.route_link_rule: A companion audience-keyed challenge route may cite stop_profile_key but may not redefine approved_stop_fields inline.
stop_contract.stop_profile_rule: A stop profile names the semantic pieces carried by one question_key and the exact narrow fields where escalation may terminate for each piece.
